Strong and em tags use underscore symbol instead of asterisk

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p><strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em></p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(strong_em_symbol: '_'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
